title: No pizzaz for this pizza maker
text: No pizzaz for this pizza maker. I like the product for what it does.  I use it mostly to heat frozen pizza and, since it has a lid, I can take half the pizza and the rest will stay fairly warm until I'm ready to finish it.  What I don't like is that it lasted about one month more than a year before it just wouldn't work.  I did order another because I can't find another pizza maker with the lid, to keep the pizza warm.  I'm hoping this one will last longer.
